gettingHere.text: We are located in Kisakasaka, Zanzibar, near Kombeni in Wilaya Magharibi 'B'. The visitor gate is marked by the school sign and flag pole.

careers.title: We Are Hiring — Join Our Team
careers.text: Be part of a dedicated team shaping future leaders! We are recruiting passionate educators for our Cambridge and NECTA wings as well as key administrative and IT specialists ahead of the January 2027 intake.

openings: Cambridge Wing Teachers — English, Art & Design, Mathematics/Science, Humanities, PE/Global Perspectives

Receptionist — Diploma/Certificate in Office Management or Administration; front desk, calls & MS Office
Media & IT Officer — Degree/Diploma in Media, ICT or Computer Science; school media content, website & IT systems
